name: Employees with a university degree
unit: % of employees living in the county
description: Share of employees subject to social insurance who live in the county and hold a university degree (bachelor, master, diploma, state examination, doctorate).

name: Average age
description: Mean age of all inhabitants on 31 December.

name: Population change over ten years
description: Change in the number of inhabitants over the previous ten years.

name: Women among 20- to 39-year-olds
description: Share of women among inhabitants aged 20 to 39; low values mean young women have moved away.

name: Industry jobs
description: Employees working in the county in industry (mining, manufacturing, energy, water, construction) per 100 inhabitants of working age.

name: Median earnings
description: Median monthly gross earnings of full-time employees working in the county.

name: Foreign nationals
description: Share of inhabitants without German citizenship (people with dual citizenship count as German).

name: Unemployment rate
description: Registered unemployed as a share of the civilian labour force (Federal Employment Agency).
